column3: [annoyed] Hey! Why'd you stop? Keep moving!
[straining] I can't! I'm stuck! There's no water down here!
[shouting up] Hey, Brain! Send some water down here!
[sleepy, lazy] Nah. I swallowed it dry. I'm going to bed.
[panicking] No, no, no! Don't lie down now!
[worried] Uh oh... I'm starting to melt.
[in pain] Ow! Ow! You're burning me!
[guilty] Sorry! Nobody gave me any water!
[worried] Doctor, it burns right here every time I swallow.
[calm] Did you take a pill last night without water?
[guilty] Yeah. Then I went straight to bed.
[calm, clear] That's called pill esophagitis. The pill got stuck in your food pipe, melted there, and burned a sore into the wall.
[warm, clear] Always take pills with a full glass of water, and stay sitting or standing for thirty minutes.
[realizing] So water is the pill's slide!
